name: Update a sender
description: Update a sender. Updates an existing email sender's configuration. Use this to: - Modify sender display name or email address - Update dedicated IP associations - Change sender configuration settings - Correct sender information Key information returned: - Success confirmation - Updated sender details

email.description: From Email to update the sender

ip.description: Dedicated IP available in your account

weight.description:
Weight to apply to the IP. Sum of all IP weights must be
100. Should be passed for either ALL or NONE of the IPs.
If it's not passed, the sending will be equally balanced
on all IPs.

ips.description:
**Only in case of dedicated IP**. IPs to associate to the
sender. If passed, will replace all the existing IPs. Not required for standard accounts.

name.description: From Name to update the sender
